Studies have utilized natural language (NL) feedback from LLMs as descriptive guidance in editing wrong codes for code LLMs... This work aims to foster building open‑source feedback models that produce effective feedback for code editing.

The task of code editing aims to resolve errors in given codes to produce a correct solution. Formally, given a problem description q and a defective solution y, our goal is to learn a feedback model θ that generates helpful feedback describing the errors in y and provide helpful guidance on code editing: ĉ = θ(q, y).
